ways.label: Roys Peak Track to the summit
evidence: The track starts at Roys Peak car park, on Wānaka – Mount Aspiring Road.
Roys Peak Track ends at the summit of Roys Peak, at 1,578 metres elevation.
From the summit, return back the way you came.

access_points.name: Wānaka (walk or cycle via Waterfall Creek Track and Glendhu Bay Track)

doubts: The Wānaka access route uses Waterfall Creek Track, Glendhu Bay Track and a section of road (not DOC managed); it is recorded as an access point to the start rather than a separate way.
